parts.note_add: The 1982 US brochure (S-004 p15) lists the rear-window wiper/washer as GSL standard equipment and not for S or GS, so on this GS it is either a dealer/optional fit or absent - confirm on the hatch. New motor 1480-67-450C is no longer available from Mazda (Atkins, 2026); used only.
Brushes are the wear item the 1985 manual names for abnormal wiper noise (S-002 sec 15 p15-43).
Catalogue BI-117-03 lists qty 2 of 8532-76-614 per motor.
Arm 1480-67-421A is discontinued by Mazda (Mazdatrix); the arm bolt cover 8134-76-641 is still sold new by Atkins Rotary and fits only the rear arm.

specs.item: Feed fuse (IG, X-04 fuse block, shared with rear washer)
specs.note: Feed L from ignition IG via 10 A fuse, becomes LB at X-03 and L at D-07 into the motor; confirm on the car

specs.value: ground-side switched: motor BG lead grounded through D-06 rear wiper & washer switch to B, X-11, X-02, X-13
specs.note: Motor has constant IG feed on L; the cabin switch completes the ground; confirm on the car

specs.value: yes - single contact inside the motor to body ground, keeps the motor running to the park position after the switch is turned off
specs.note: Drawn inside D-05 with its own ground symbol (no connector pin); confirm on the car

specs.value: GSL only (listed as GSL addition over GS: rear-window wiper/washer)
specs.note: Whether this GS has one fitted - confirm on the hatch

specs.item: Bench test: battery + to motor connector terminal A, - to terminals B and C
specs.note: 1985 workshop manual only; the page says a battery, no voltage figure; 1982 S-001 shows two harness leads L and BG plus an internal ground, so the A/B/C letters are 1985 - confirm on the car

specs.item: Circuit check: voltage between line L and body ground, ignition ON
specs.value: voltage present (none: check the fuse or repair the harness)
specs.note: 1985 manual gives no voltage figure on this page; the troubleshooting table (p15-43) names the fuse R. WIPER; 1982 wiring agrees the L lead is IG-fed (S-001 D p18)

specs.item: Troubleshooting causes when rear wiper does not work
specs.value: R. WIPER fuse blown; faulty rear wiper motor; faulty rear wiper switch; faulty wiring or ground
specs.note: 1985 manual; abnormal noise causes listed: brush wear, loose motor mounting screw, insufficient grease in link joint
Retailer listing weight; listed NLA, fits 1981-85
Blade-size lookup site gives 17 in for driver, passenger and rear, 1979-84 and 1985; no factory source seen - measure the blade on the car; confirm

terminals.to: D-07 connector (LB side) - X-03 - LB bus - X-04 10 A fuse - ignition IG
terminals.note: from S-001; bullet connector at D-05; confirm on the car

terminals.inside: other motor brush (armature -), also joined to the internal park switch
terminals.to: D-07 - X-03 - X-12 - X-11 - D-06 rear wiper & washer switch (wiper contact) - B - X-11 - X-02 - ground X-13
terminals.note: from S-001; bullet connector at D-05; confirm on the car

terminals.inside: internal park switch contact, closed except at the park position
terminals.note: from S-001, drawn as a ground symbol inside D-05 with no connector pin; how it is grounded (case, eyelet or third lead) - confirm on the car
